title: Hardware Procurement Deposit, Invoice and Late Fee Terms by Order Type
content:
The Hardware Procurement accounts receivable terms below apply per order type. A deposit is invoiced on approval as a percentage of the quote total when a deposit is required; the deposit threshold is the quote total at or above which a deposit is required, and a threshold of 0 means a deposit is always required when the deposit percentage is above 0.

| Order type | Deposit (percent of quote total) | Deposit threshold (USD) | Deposit falls due | Other invoices due (days after posting) | Largest invoice payable by card (USD) | Monthly late fee (percent of unpaid balance) | Grace after due date (calendar days) | Minimum late fee per invoice per month (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | 0 | 0.00 | on receipt | 30 | 5000.00 | 1.5 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Standard Endpoint Order | 25 | 5000.00 | on receipt | 30 | 10000.00 | 1.5 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Staged Endpoint Order | 25 | 5000.00 | on receipt | 30 | 10000.00 | 1.5 | 5 | 25.00 |
| Network Equipment Order | 50 | 0.00 | on receipt | 30 | 10000.00 | 1.5 | 10 | 35.00 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 50 | 0.00 | on receipt | 30 | 15000.00 | 1.5 | 10 | 50.00 |
| Special-Order Equipment | 100 | 0.00 | on receipt | 15 | 15000.00 | 1.5 | 5 | 50.00 |

## How the columns read

- An Accessory & Peripheral Order has a deposit percentage of 0, so no deposit is required on it at any quote total.
- On a Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order the threshold of 5000.00 decides: a quote total of 5000.00 or more requires a deposit, a total of 4999.99 does not.
- Network Equipment, Server & Storage Build and Special-Order Equipment orders have a threshold of 0, so every such order requires a deposit.
- Every deposit invoice is due on receipt; the other invoices fall due the stated number of calendar days after they are posted.
- The card limit is tested against the invoice's total: a hypothetical Network Equipment invoice of 10000.00 may be paid by card, one of 10000.01 may not.
